comment: Read from src/Simone.cpp at commit 71e0bcb, the last commit whose plugin.json carries the installed 2.0.30. Three things the manual does not say. Drive is not a drive: LydFilter.h:162 crossfades a lowpass and a highpass of the same signal, and Simone.cpp:399 uses the knob as that crossfade position, so the knob moves the output from lowpass to highpass with no non-linearity anywhere. The Wave knob also sets that filter's corner, at 220 times two to the power of the Wave value (Simone.cpp:401). The Gain attenuverter offsets the Gain knob when nothing is patched, because Simone.cpp:393 substitutes 1 for an unconnected jack rather than 0, so the attenuverter's setting is added to the knob directly. The big knob is configured as Speed while the panel prints Pitch, and the range button is configured as Range while the panel prints Speed, so both hover texts differ from the panel. The panel-theme submenu is plugin-wide and cosmetic, so it has no line. The Speed jacks are marked pitch rather than cv because the module comes up on its Voice range, where they set an audible pitch at one volt per octave.
